Home / Services / Hollow metal doors & hardware

Hollow metal door and hardware installation in Winnipeg

We install hollow metal frames, doors and finish hardware on commercial and multi-family projects. Labour-only packages are welcome — send us the door schedule and we will price it.

Doors are installed to the door and hardware schedules: frames set plumb and square, doors hung with even gaps, and hardware fitted and adjusted so every opening closes and latches.

We work for door and hardware suppliers who need an install crew, and for general contractors who want the whole door package installed by one company.

Request a quote

What is included

  • Hollow metal frames and doors
  • Finish hardware installed to the hardware schedule
  • Fire-rated openings
  • Labour-only installation for suppliers and general contractors

Common questions

Do you take labour-only door packages?
Yes. The supplier or general contractor provides the frames, doors and hardware, and we install them to the schedule.
What do you need to price a door package?
The door schedule, the hardware schedule and the floor plans, plus the project schedule.
Do you work outside Winnipeg?
Yes. We are based in Winnipeg and take projects across Manitoba.
